integrity: The proof treats arbitrary finite undirected graphs. A separate exact exhaustive checker samples finite instances only; its tests are not a substitute for the proof. Publication priority remains subject to unindexed literature.
scientific_limitations: The converse assumes at least two available actions unused by stubborn players and a common action set of size at least three; it concerns arbitrary strict better responses and does not establish nonconvergence under every scheduler. No classification of all binary or near-saturated pinned-color games.
title: A sharp finite-improvement dichotomy for multi-action conformist–rebel network games
